title: In sendAnomalyProfile of ProfilingService.java, there is a possible path traversal issue due to path… (CVE-2026-59016)
description: CVE-2026-59016 is a vulnerability in the sendAnomalyProfile function of ProfilingService.java involving a path traversal issue. This flaw could allow an attacker to escalate privileges locally without needing additional execution rights or user interaction.
